raw_response:
1. The figure does not show any error bars for MADLLM on either PSM or SMD, so you can’t infer greater variability for PSM from this plot.

2. The plot does not show MADLLM w/o feature embedding at 85% on SMAP; it appears around ~69–70%, while full MADLLM is around ~93%. The gap suggests feature embedding contributes substantially to performance on SMAP.

3. The figure provides only point estimates (no variance, sample sizes, or statistical test results), so a p-value/statistical significance cannot be determined from it; you therefore can’t conclude statistical significance, though the F1 gap visually looks large on several datasets.
